verdict.rationale: Unity documents launching the Editor with command-line arguments to automate workflows, and a probe notes the editor's -batchmode/-nographics CLI is documented for headless CI builds. The Unity CLI is positioned for CI build agents without the Hub, and Unity Build Automation offers hosted CI multiplatform builds. Community reports that seat costs kept a team from running a CI build server describe a licensing cost, not a technical failure of headless builds. Missing for 10: an explicit documented excerpt of the build/export invocation (e.g. a build-target or execute-method flag driving the build pipeline), and independent hands-on corroboration of a headless CI export.
